The '''United Kingdom Census 1971''' was a [[census]] of the [[United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland]] carried out on 25 April 1971. The census will be released in 2071.<ref>[http://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/education/resources/census-detective/ Census detective.] The National Archive. Retrieved 6 July 2017.</ref>

A test census for this census year was conducted in 1968.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Newman |first=Dennis |date=1971 |title=The Planning of the 1971 Census of Population |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/2987033 |journal=Journal of the Royal Statistical Society. Series D (The Statistician) |volume=20 |issue=2 |pages=15–31 |doi=10.2307/2987033 |issn=0039-0526|url-access=subscription }}</ref> According to the preliminary general results of the census, the population of the United Kingdom on 25 April 1971 was as follows:<ref>{{Cite book |last=Paxton |first=J. |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=iejIDQAAQBAJ&dq=%2243,460,525%22+%2225+april+1971%22&pg=PA69 |title=The Statesman's Year-Book 1975-76 |date=2016-12-22 |publisher=Springer |isbn=978-0-230-27104-3 |pages=69, 132 |language=en}}</ref>

The 1971 census was the first to ask when a foreign born resident arrived to the UK,<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Dale |first=Angela |title=The research value of the census of population: experiences from the UK |url=https://hummedia.manchester.ac.uk/institutes/cmist/archive-publications/occasional-papers/17-research-value-of-the-census.pdf}}</ref> however this was not continued again until 2011. In addition to removed census questions, it was the first to ask residents about their parents' country of birth,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ethnic minority entrepreneurship in Britain |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/46542782_Ethnic_minority_entrepreneurship_in_Britain}}</ref> which was not asked again in any other census following. It was the first census additionally that allowed for the outputting of small area geography statistics in enumeration districts,<ref name=":0" /> and asked for specific date of birth instead of just the present age of residents to get a more precise age at the date of the census.<ref name=":0" />
